input: Find church and faith-based day camps (other than Vacation Bible School) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: Downtown: FirstShine day camp for teenagers and young adults with special needs ran July 27–30, 2026, with games, crafts, swimming and outings.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Charlotte Street: Camp Ruach offers Jewish-values day camp and teen leadership training; summer 2027 begins June 14.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian outdoor day camp for rising K–6th graders, plus overnight youth camps; 2026 offerings include swimming, archery, crafts and ziplining.

candidates.name: Arden Seventh-day Adventist Church
candidates.note: FLAG Camp serves ages 5–12; seven weeks of Christian weekday day camp ran June 15–July 31, 2026.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers PreKamp for ages 3–6, K–4th-grade day camp, and overnight youth adventure and music programs for summer 2027.

candidates.name: Hominy Baptist Church of Candler
candidates.note: Summer childcare camp serves Enka-district students from mid-June to mid-August, with swimming, educational outings, bowling and other field trips.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 school-age camps include sports, skills and academic enrichment; most are half-day, and children need not attend the school.

candidates.name: Veritas Christian Academy
candidates.note: Camp Veritas offered summer learning and adventure programs in July 2026 at the Christian school's Fletcher campus.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer 2026 included the supervised Clubs program for children and youth, alongside summer youth conferences.

candidates.name: United Methodist Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included day camps, overnight camps, adventure camps and Barnabas special-needs camps.
